name: MASTER OX & THE CHICKEN TEMPLE
author: Mind_the_Brick
description:
High up on the mountains, Master Ox is in in dire straits... and desperately needs your help! 
You need to find all the lost chickens and return them to the Chicken Temple!

The Game features 3 levels which you can explore
Helpful lanterns which will guide you through the game
Many obstacles on your way to the temple
Two evils characters which will try to stop you from winning
And many Easter eggs...

I hope you have fun playing it as I did making the game!!!                         Designed by Mind the brick
